text:
Type: house-shaped picture frames, set of four
Use: displaying photos or drawings on a wall; children's room, playroom, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: white plastic fronts with cut-out picture openings
Colors: white, light grey inserts
Shape: flat silhouettes of little houses, a tower and trees with arched and square windows for pictures, a playful skyline when hung in a row, light and thin
Feel: playful, sweet, cheerful, light
Goes with: white walls, pastel colors, light wood, children's furniture; Scandinavian nurseries and kids' rooms

product.name: GLON
product.description: You can have fun colouring and personalising each building any way you like.
